2608.12121.title: QV-PIC: Query-Aware Visual Position-Independent Caching for Efficient RAG Serving
2608.12121.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) repeatedly prefills identical text chunks across queries, incurring redundant computations. Position-Independent Caching (PIC) mitigates it by reusing precomputed Key-Value (KV) across positions, but its efficiency is constrained by the large volume of text tokens. Rendering text chunks as images can compress the text into fewer visual tokens, but the rendered-image PIC suffers more severe quality degradation than the text PIC. This representation-specific gap primarily arises from contextual mismatches across independently compiled caches and the loss of fine-grained textual evidence during visual compression. Existing PIC repair methods mainly address the former through selective recomputation, but they incur online computation and cannot recover lost textual details. We propose QV-PIC, a query-aware dual-resolution PIC reuse framework guided by model-native templates. Offline, QV-PIC compiles visual caches under the model's native chat-template prefix, improving PIC quality without online recomputation. Online, it preserves global context with low resolution and restores fine-grained textual evidence within a high-resolution budget by cumulative query relevance scores, retaining the efficiency benefit of visual compression. Across six tasks, QV-PIC improves average F1 by 21.6 points over vanilla rendered-image PIC, closes the gap to vanilla text PIC, and surpasses optimized text PIC by 2.58 F1 while reducing TTFT by 17.2\%. Relative to full prefill, it cuts TTFT by 83.8%.
2608.12121.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）在查詢中重複填充相同的文本塊，導致冗餘計算。位置獨立緩存（PIC）通過在不同位置重用預計算的鍵值（KV）來減輕這一問題，但其效率受到大量文本標記的限制。將文本塊呈現為圖像可以將文本壓縮為更少的視覺標記，但呈現圖像的PIC比文本的PIC承受更嚴重的質量下降。這種特定於表示的差距主要源於獨立編譯的緩存之間的上下文不匹配，以及在視覺壓縮過程中細粒度文本證據的喪失。現有的PIC修復方法主要通過選擇性重新計算來解決前者，但它們會產生在線計算，並且無法恢復丟失的文本細節。我們提出了QV-PIC，一種由模型原生模板指導的查詢感知雙解析度PIC重用框架。在離線階段，QV-PIC在模型的原生聊天模板前綴下編譯視覺緩存，改善PIC質量而無需在線重新計算。在在線階段，它以低解析度保留全局上下文，並通過累積查詢相關性分數在高解析度預算內恢復細粒度文本證據，保留視覺壓縮的效率優勢。在六個任務中，QV-PIC使平均F1提高了21.6分，縮小了與原始文本PIC的差距，並在減少TTFT 17.2\%的同時超越了優化的文本PIC 2.58 F1。相對於完全預填，它將TTFT減少了83.8%。
